versions.subject: Unsupported rule now possible with Sysmonv13.30
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentUser:
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE'
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\LOCAL SERVICE'
        - 'AUTORITE NT\Sys' # French language settings
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
rundllexception:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'DavSetCookie'
condition: selection and not rundllexception
versions.spl: ParentUser IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\NETWORK SERVICE", "NT AUTHORITY\\LOCAL SERVICE", "AUTORITE NT\\Sys") User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM" NOT (Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine="*DavSetCookie*")

c.t: P:ParentUser|IN|('L', (('S', 'AUTORITE NT\\\\Sys'), ('S', 'NT AUTHORITY\\\\LOCAL SERVICE'), ('S', 'NT AUTHORITY\\\\NETWORK SERVICE')))|CTX:POS
